pullRequest.body:
## Summary
- establish the v0.1 milestone-backed execution sequence and attendance boundary
- reconcile the approved separate Help-window decision
- add T11 adapter-composition and T12 ISUI feasibility runbooks/evidence templates
- add a guarded, API-grounded disposable T12 UI probe
- review Dead Air content continuity and refresh stale T8/T10 fixture annotations without changing authored bodies

## Verification
- git diff --check main...HEAD
- all six fixture document bodies match Content.lua byte-for-byte
- T12 candidate API names checked against the installed Build 42 Lua sources
- live T11/T12 results intentionally remain unclaimed

Closes no gate automatically. Tracks #25, #26, #28, #29, and #30; prepares #31 and #27.
pullRequest.title: Establish v0.1 pre-assembly gates and T12 UI probe
pullRequest.head: pm/v0.1-unattended-prep
pullRequest.display_title: Establish v0.1 pre-assembly gates and T12 UI probe

issues.title: Close Dead Air human content-approval gate
issues.body: Resolve CF-V01-P03 for content revision dead-air-r1 under docs/design/AI_PROVENANCE.md. The project owner must explicitly approve the six AI-assisted authored documents or return a bounded change list. Record the dated result and update the fixture, acceptance criteria, traceability report, and project state consistently. This issue cannot be closed by technical review alone.
issues.display_title: Close Dead Air human content-approval gate

issues.title: [Gate T12] Validate v0.1 ISUI notebook runtime feasibility
issues.body: Prove or disprove the approved UI assumptions in live Project Zomboid: custom movable/resizable multi-pane window, independent document scrolling, right-edge Journal/Evidence tabs, compact breakpoint, Escape/focus restoration, configured font scaling/relayout, controller route, remembered geometry, and coexistence with vanilla/foreign UI. Record unsupported behavior and feed corrections back into the UI specifications before production notebook Lua begins.
issues.display_title: [Gate T12] Validate v0.1 ISUI notebook runtime feasibility

issues.title: Execute and sign off the v0.1 live acceptance matrix
issues.body: Run CF-V01-E01 through E13 against the supported Build 42 line after production assembly. Cover save/reload and staged rejection, death/reload, exact-once placement, fallback, physical moves/loss/conflict, all authored readers, arrival negatives, cooperative menus, multiplayer disablement, <=2 ms/frame behavior, and adapter fault containment. Archive reproducible evidence and accept the slice only when every product, content, and engine criterion passes.
issues.display_title: Execute and sign off the v0.1 live acceptance matrix

issues.title: Finalize Dead Air P2/R2 live location binding
issues.body: Complete CF-V01-E01 from the checkpoint on design/dead-air-location-binding-live. Verify the target Project Zomboid build/profile, reveal and review the bounded regional road corridor, run candidate-specific adjacent/wrong-room/wrong-floor T8 negatives, and bind P2/R2 only if all checks pass. Record exact failures and inspect the smallest fallback only when required. Requires project-owner/manual GUI attendance for the live pass.
issues.display_title: Finalize Dead Air P2/R2 live location binding

issues.title: [Gate T11] Compose v0.1 PZ adapters on one real fixture
issues.body: Before full slice assembly, exercise T4 placement, T5 physical identity, T8 arrival detection, T10 Inspect/Mark Interesting, T1-style canonical persistence, and the accepted domain core together on one bound Dead Air item. Include discovery during target streaming, Inspect followed by immediate save, same-tick arrival and placement/identity reconciliation, reload, duplicate-token conflict, and contained injected faults. Publish observed evidence and limitations; do not promote probe code directly to production.
issues.display_title: [Gate T11] Compose v0.1 PZ adapters on one real fixture

issues.title: Reconcile approved v0.1 UI and remaining product decisions
issues.body: Update the authoritative decision index to reflect the already-approved separate Help utility window and right-edge Journal/Evidence tabs. Obtain and record owner decisions for police-location major-discovery treatment, player visibility of untracked/conflict physical states, and death-recap inclusion/ownership. Reconcile ROADMAP, PLAYER_MOMENTS, acceptance criteria, and UI workspace status without claiming unresolved choices are approved.
issues.display_title: Reconcile approved v0.1 UI and remaining product decisions

issues.title: Assemble the production Dead Air v0.1 vertical slice
issues.body: After location binding, T11, T12, content approval, and decision reconciliation, implement the production PZ adapters and approved UI for six documents, optional B-37 Mark Interesting, two curated locations, anchor/fallback, journal/evidence projections, persistence, exact-once placement, identity reconciliation, arrival confirmation, Inspect, and clean multiplayer disablement. Keep graph, theories, runtime AI, content packs, retrofit, migrations, and multiplayer support out of scope.
issues.display_title: Assemble the production Dead Air v0.1 vertical slice
